usage_note: Only the head noun 'izlase' (feminine, 5th declension) declines; 'Kanādas hokeja' is a fixed genitive attribute. In running sports copy the country name alone is common (Kanāda – Kanādas – Kanādai – Kanādu – Kanādā), also 'kanādieši' (plural) for the players, e.g. 'Latvija pret Kanādu', 'zaudējums kanādiešiem'. No quotes, since this is a national team, not a club.
